The decisive mistake was Validation_Expert's fix at step 7. After the first scraping script failed with an AttributeError, it rewrote the parser by guessing a "Number" table-row structure without inspecting the page. The debug line that would have printed the HTML was left commented out. The script returned `None`, and the team never obtained a jersey number, let alone the names of pitchers 18 and 20. Every later step built on this unverified approach instead of switching to a source that lists numbers and names (such as a 2023 team roster).
